a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan needs 2 operate rounds first. That gives about a 4% chance that anyone survives. The reserve has exactly 4 cells, enough for one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither reaches 4. If you have a better idea, say so, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
